translations.idiomatic: The way I identified the prolapse condition was that her pulse was large and solid, arriving with difficulty—this is the characteristic movement of the Jueyin channel.

sentences.zh: 脈來難者，疝氣之客於膀胱也。

translations.literal: Pulse coming difficult means hernia energy guesting at bladder.
translations.idiomatic: When the pulse arrives with difficulty, it indicates hernia energy lodged in the bladder.

sentences.zh: 腹之所以腫者，言蹶陰之絡結小肮也。

translations.literal: The reason abdomen swells is that jueyin's network knots small intestines.
translations.idiomatic: The reason for the abdominal swelling was that the Jueyin connecting vessel had knotted around the small intestine.

sentences.zh: 蹶陰有過則脈結動，動則腹腫。

translations.literal: Jueyin having excess then pulse knots move, move then abdomen swells.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jueyin channel is in excess, the pulse becomes knotted and agitated; when it is agitated, the abdomen swells.

sentences.zh: 臣意即灸其足蹶陰之脈，左右各一所，即不遺溺而溲清，小肮痛止。

translations.literal: Minister Yi then moxibusted his foot jueyin pulse, left and right each one place, then not incontinent yet urine clear, small intestine pain stopped.
translations.idiomatic: I applied moxibustion to the Foot Jueyin channel, one point on each side. The incontinence ceased, her urine ran clear, and the pain in the lower abdomen subsided.

sentences.zh: 即更為火齊湯以飲之，三日而疝氣散，即愈。

translations.literal: Then further made fire elixir soup to drink it, three days and hernia energy dispersed, then cured.
translations.idiomatic: I then prepared a Fire Formula Decoction for her to drink, and after three days the hernia energy dispersed and she was cured.

sentences.zh: 故濟北王阿母自言足熱而懣，臣意告曰：「熱蹶也。」

translations.literal: Therefore the wet nurse of the king of Jibei said herself that her feet were hot and she felt oppressed. I told her: "Heat reversal."
translations.idiomatic: The king of Jibei's foster mother complained that her feet burned and she felt stifled. I told her: "Heat reversal."

sentences.zh: 則刺其足心各三所，案之無出血，病旋已。

translations.literal: I then needled the center of each foot in three places and pressed the sites until no blood appeared; the illness was quickly cured.
translations.idiomatic: I needled the center of each sole three times, pressing until no blood came forth, and the disease was soon gone.

sentences.zh: 病得之飲酒大醉。

translations.literal: Illness came from drinking wine greatly drunk.
translations.idiomatic: The illness had arisen from becoming severely intoxicated.

sentences.zh: 濟北王召臣意診脈諸女子侍者，至女子豎，豎無病。

translations.literal: The king of Jibei summoned me to feel the pulses of his female attendants. When I came to the woman Shu, she showed no illness.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Jibei called me to examine the pulses of the palace women. I reached the attendant Shu and found no disease.

sentences.zh: 臣意告永巷長曰：「豎傷脾，不可勞，法當春嘔血死。」

translations.literal: I told the director of the rear apartments: "Shu has injured her spleen and must not labor; by rule she should vomit blood and die in spring."
translations.idiomatic: I informed the overseer of the inner quarters: "Shu's spleen is harmed and she cannot exert herself. According to the pattern she will spit blood and die in spring."

sentences.zh: 臣意言王曰：「才人女子豎何能？」

translations.literal: I said to the king: "What ability has the talented woman Shu?"
translations.idiomatic: I told the king: "Of what use is the talented attendant Shu?"

sentences.zh: 王曰：「是好為方，多伎能，為所是案法新，往年市之民所，四百七十萬，曹偶四人。」

translations.literal: Wang said: "This good become method, many ji neng, become suo shi an fa xin, go year shi zhi min suo, four hundred seven ten wan, Cao ou four person."
translations.idiomatic: The king said: "This one is good at methods, many skills and abilities, becomes what is approved by law as new, from the previous year market among the people, four hundred seventy thousand, Cao Ou four people."

sentences.zh: 王曰：「得毋有病乎？」

translations.literal: Wang said: "Get wu have illness?"
translations.idiomatic: The king said: "Does she not have illness?"

sentences.zh: 臣意對曰：「豎病重，在死法中。」

translations.literal: I replied: "Shu's illness is grave; it falls within the laws of death."
translations.idiomatic: I answered: "Shu's disease is severe and belongs to the category that ends in death."

sentences.zh: 王召視之，其顏色不變，以為不然，不賣諸侯所。

translations.literal: The king summoned to see her, her complexion unchanged, considered it not so, did not sell her to feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: The king summoned her for inspection, but since her complexion had not changed, he thought my diagnosis was wrong and did not sell her to another lord's household.

sentences.zh: 至春，豎奉劍從王之廁，王去，豎後，王令人召之，即仆於廁，嘔血死。

translations.literal: Reaching spring, Shu holding sword followed the king to the toilet, king left, Shu behind, king had someone summon her, then she collapsed in the toilet, vomited blood and died.
translations.idiomatic: When spring came, Shu was carrying a sword and following the king to the privy. The king left, and Shu fell behind. When the king sent someone to summon her, they found that she had collapsed in the privy, vomiting blood, and was dead.

sentences.zh: 病得之流汗。

translations.literal: Illness came from flowing sweat.
translations.idiomatic: The illness arose from profuse sweating.

sentences.zh: 流汗者，（同）法病內重，毛發而色澤，脈不衰，此亦（關）內［關］之病也。

translations.literal: Flowing sweat: by the diagnostic rule this is internal heaviness—the hair issues forth yet the complexion remains lustrous and the pulse does not decline. This too is an internal barrier illness.
translations.idiomatic: Profuse sweating: by the canon this indicates inward severity—the hair stands out yet the color stays bright and the pulse does not weaken. This is likewise a disease of inward obstruction.

sentences.zh: 齊中大夫病齲齒，臣意灸其左大陽明脈，即為苦參湯，日嗽三升，出入五六日，病已。

translations.literal: Qi central grandee fell ill with decayed teeth, Minister Yi moxibusted his left great yangming pulse, then made kushen soup, gargled three sheng per day, coming and going five or six days, illness cured.
translations.idiomatic: A palace grandee of Qi was suffering from tooth decay. I applied moxibustion to his left Greater Yang Brightness channel, then prepared a Bitter Sophora Decoction. He gargled with three sheng per day, and after five or six days of treatment the ailment was cured.

sentences.zh: 得之風，及臥開口，食而不嗽。

translations.literal: Got it from wind, and sleeping with mouth open, eating but not gargling.
translations.idiomatic: The condition had come from exposure to wind, sleeping with the mouth open, and eating without rinsing the mouth afterward.

sentences.zh: 菑川王美人懷子而不乳，來召臣意。

translations.literal: Zaichuan King's beauty pregnant with child but no milk, came to summon Minister Yi.
translations.idiomatic: A consort of the King of Zichuan was pregnant but unable to produce milk, and so I was summoned.

sentences.zh: 臣意往，飲以莨碭藥一撮，以酒飲之，旋乳。

translations.literal: Minister Yi went, had her drink langdang medicine one pinch, drank it with wine, immediately produced milk.
translations.idiomatic: I went to her and administered a pinch of langdang medicine dissolved in wine. She promptly began to produce milk.

sentences.zh: 臣意復診其脈，而脈躁。

translations.literal: Minister Yi again diagnosed her pulse, but pulse agitated.
translations.idiomatic: I examined her pulse again and found it still agitated.

sentences.zh: 躁者有餘病，即飲以消石一齊，出血，血如豆比五六枚。

translations.literal: Agitated means has excess illness, then drank with xiaoshi one elixir, expelled blood, blood like bean size five or six pieces.
translations.idiomatic: An agitated pulse indicates a residual illness. I gave her one dose of a mineral salt formula, and she expelled blood—five or six clots the size of beans.

sentences.zh: 齊丞相舍人奴從朝入宮，臣意見之食閨門外，望其色有病氣。

translations.literal: Qi chancellor's retainer slave from court entered palace, Minister Yi saw him eating outside the palace gate, observed his complexion had illness energy.
translations.idiomatic: A servant in the retinue of the Chancellor of Qi was on his way from court into the palace. I happened to see him eating outside the inner gate and noticed from his complexion that he bore the signs of illness.

sentences.zh: 臣意即告宦者平。

translations.literal: Minister Yi then told eunuch Ping.
translations.idiomatic: I informed the eunuch Ping of what I had observed.

sentences.zh: 平好為脈，學臣意所，臣意即示之舍人奴病，告之曰：「此傷脾氣也，當至春鬲塞不通，不能食飲，法至夏泄血死。」

translations.literal: Ping was skilled at pulse diagnosis and studied under me. I showed him the retainer-slave's illness and told him: "This has injured the spleen qi. By spring the diaphragm will be blocked and he will be unable to eat or drink; by rule he should bleed and die in summer."
translations.idiomatic: Ping excelled at pulse reading and trained with me. I pointed out the house slave's condition and said: "His spleen qi is harmed. When spring comes the diaphragm will seal shut and he will neither eat nor drink; by the pattern he will discharge blood and die in summer."

sentences.zh: 宦者平即往告相曰：「君之舍人奴有病，病重，死期有日。」

translations.literal: The eunuch Ping went at once to inform the chancellor: "Your lordship's household slave is ill; the illness is severe, and the day of death is near."
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Ping hurried to tell the chancellor: "Your retainer's slave is gravely ill; death is only days away."

sentences.zh: 相君曰：「卿何以知之？」

translations.literal: The chancellor said: "How do you know this?"
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor asked: "How can you know that?"

sentences.zh: 曰：「君朝時入宮，君之舍人奴盡食閨門外，平與倉公立，即示平曰，病如是者死。」

translations.literal: I said: "When your lordship entered court in the morning, your house slaves were all eating outside the inner gate. Ping and I were standing there, and I showed Ping that an illness like this means death."
translations.idiomatic: "When you went to court this morning," I said, "your slaves were eating outside the palace gate. Ping and I were present, and I showed him that such a disease is fatal."

sentences.zh: 相即召舍人（奴）而謂之曰：「公奴有病不？」

translations.literal: The chancellor at once summoned the house slave and asked him: "Do you have an illness or not?"
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor immediately called the slave in and demanded: "Are you ill or not?"

sentences.zh: 舍人曰：「奴無病，身無痛者。」

translations.literal: She ren said: "Nu no illness, body no tong person."
translations.idiomatic: The retainer said: "Slave has no illness, body has no pain."

sentences.zh: 至春果病，至四月，泄血死。

translations.literal: Reaching spring indeed fell ill, reaching fourth month, bled blood and died.
translations.idiomatic: When spring came, the servant indeed fell ill, and by the fourth month he was bleeding profusely and died.

sentences.zh: 所以知奴病者，脾氣周乘五藏，傷部而交，故傷脾之色也，望之殺然黃，察之如死青之茲。

translations.literal: The reason I knew the slave's illness was spleen energy completely multiplying five viscera, injuring the part and intersecting, therefore injuring spleen's color, observing it bleakly yellow, examining it like dead azure this appearance.
translations.idiomatic: The way I identified the servant's illness was that the spleen energy had overwhelmed all five organs, damaging each in turn as it crossed between them. This injured the spleen's characteristic color: from a distance it appeared a sickly yellow, and on close examination it took on the livid hue of deathly blue-green.

sentences.zh: 眾醫不知，以為大蟲，不知傷脾。

translations.literal: All doctors did not know, considered it large worm, did not know injured spleen.
translations.idiomatic: The other physicians failed to recognize the condition and diagnosed it as a parasitic worm, not realizing that the spleen had been injured.

sentences.zh: 所以至春死病者，胃氣黃，黃者土氣也，土不勝木，故至春死。

translations.literal: The reason reaching spring the illness dies is stomach energy yellow, yellow is earth energy, earth not conquering wood, therefore reaching spring dies.
translations.idiomatic: The reason the fatal illness arrived in spring was that the stomach energy was yellow, and yellow corresponds to the element of earth. Earth cannot overcome wood, and since spring is the season of wood, the patient died at that time.

sentences.zh: 所以至夏死者，脈法曰「病重而脈順清者曰內關」，內關之病，人不知其所痛，心急然無苦。

translations.literal: So reach summer die person, pulse law say "illness zhong yet pulse shun qing person say nei guan", nei guan zhi illness, person not know its suo tong, heart ji ran no ku.
translations.idiomatic: The reason reaching summer dies is pulse law says "illness heavy yet pulse smooth clear called inner barrier", inner barrier illness, person does not know its painful place, heart urgently yet no suffering.

sentences.zh: 若加以一病，死中春；

translations.literal: If one more illness is added, he will die in mid-spring;
translations.idiomatic: Should another disease be superadded, he will die in the middle of spring;

sentences.zh: 一愈順，及一時。

translations.literal: One cure smooth, reaching one time.
translations.idiomatic: One sign of smooth recovery extends the prognosis by one season.

sentences.zh: 其所以四月死者，診其人時愈順。

translations.literal: The reason four months die is diagnosing the person at that time cured smooth.
translations.idiomatic: The reason he died in the fourth month was that when I examined him, his condition still appeared to be running its smooth course.

sentences.zh: 愈順者，人尚肥也。

translations.literal: Cured smooth means person still fat.
translations.idiomatic: That the condition appeared smooth meant simply that the man was still well-nourished.

sentences.zh: 奴之病得之流汗數出，（灸）［炙］於火而以出見大風也。

translations.literal: The slave's illness came from sweating repeatedly, being heated over fire, and then going out into a great wind."
translations.idiomatic: He contracted the disease by sweating often, being warmed at a fire, and then exposing himself to a strong wind."

sentences.zh: 菑川王病，召臣意診脈，曰：「蹶上為重，頭痛身熱，使人煩懣。」

translations.literal: The king of Zichuan fell ill and summoned me to feel his pulse. I said: "Reversal rising upward is severe; headache, heat in the body, and vexation in the patient."
translations.idiomatic: When the king of Zichuan took ill he called me to examine his pulse. I reported: "Upward reversal is grave—headache, bodily heat, and oppressive distress."

sentences.zh: 臣意即以寒水拊其頭，刺足陽明脈，左右各三所，病旋已。

translations.literal: Minister Yi then with cold water patted his head, stabbed foot yangming pulse, left and right each three places, illness quickly cured.
translations.idiomatic: I applied cold water to his head and needled the Foot Yang Brightness channel at three points on each side. The illness was quickly cured.

sentences.zh: 病得之沐發未乾而臥。

translations.literal: Illness came from washing hair not dry and sleeping.
translations.idiomatic: The illness had arisen from going to sleep with his hair still wet after washing.

sentences.zh: 診如前，所以蹶，頭熱至肩。

translations.literal: Diagnosed like before, therefore reversal, head hot reaching shoulders.
translations.idiomatic: The diagnosis was as before: the cause was a reversal of energy, with heat in the head extending down to the shoulders.

sentences.zh: 齊王黃姬兄黃長卿家有酒召客，召臣意。

translations.literal: Qi King's Huang Ji's brother Huang Changqing's home had wine summoned guests, summoned Minister Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Changqing, the brother of the King of Qi's consort Huang Ji, held a wine banquet at his home and invited guests, including myself.

sentences.zh: 諸客坐，未上食。

translations.literal: The various guests were seated, food not yet served.
translations.idiomatic: The guests were all seated, though the food had not yet been served.

sentences.zh: 臣意望見王后弟宋建，告曰：「君有病，往四五日，君要脅痛不可俛仰，又不得小溲。

translations.literal: I caught sight of the queen's younger brother Song Jian and told him: "You are ill. In four or five days your waist and ribs will ache so that you cannot bend or straighten, and you will be unable to urinate.
translations.idiomatic: I saw the queen's brother Song Jian and warned him: "You are already sick. Within four or five days pain in the waist and flanks will keep you from bending or rising, and you will not be able to pass water.

sentences.zh: 不亟治，病即入濡腎。

translations.literal: If not urgently treated, the illness will then enter the moist kidney.
translations.idiomatic: If not treated urgently, the illness would penetrate into the kidneys.

sentences.zh: 及其未舍五藏，急治之。

translations.literal: When it has not yet settled in the five viscera, urgently treat it.
translations.idiomatic: While the disease has not yet settled in the five organs, it must be treated at once.

sentences.zh: 病方今客腎濡，此所謂『腎痹』也。」

translations.literal: Illness just now ke shen ru, this so call "shen bi".
translations.idiomatic: The illness is currently guesting in the moist kidney, this is what is called 'kidney blockage.'

sentences.zh: 宋建曰：「然，建故有要脊痛。

translations.literal: Song Jian said: "Ran, Jian gu have yao ji pain.
translations.idiomatic: Song Jian said: "Yes, Jian indeed had waist and spine pain.

sentences.zh: 往四五日，天雨，黃氏諸倩見建家京下方石，即弄之，建亦欲效之，效之不能起，即復置之。

translations.literal: Four or five days ago, it rained, the Huang clan ladies saw Jian's family's capital square stone, then played with it, Jian also wanted to imitate them, imitated but could not rise, then put it back.
translations.idiomatic: Four or five days earlier, it had rained. The women of the Huang family caught sight of a large square stone in Jian's courtyard and amused themselves by lifting it. Jian tried to imitate them but could not straighten up after lifting, so he set the stone back down.

sentences.zh: 暮，要脊痛，不得溺，至今不愈。」

translations.literal: Mu, yao ji pain, not able ni, reach now not cure."
translations.idiomatic: In the evening, waist and spine pain, could not urinate, until now not cured."

sentences.zh: 建病得之好持重。

translations.literal: Jian's illness came from liking to lift heavy things.
translations.idiomatic: Jian's illness arose from his fondness for lifting heavy objects.

sentences.zh: 所以知建病者，臣意見其色，太陽色乾，腎部上及界要以下者枯四分所，故以往四五日知其發也。

translations.literal: The reason I knew Jian's illness was that Minister Yi observed his color—taiyang color dry, kidney region from above to boundary waist below withered four fen area, therefore knowing four or five days ago it would erupt.
translations.idiomatic: The way I identified Jian's illness was by observing his complexion: the Taiyang region was dry, and the kidney zone from above the waist boundary down to below it appeared withered over an area of about four divisions. From this I knew the condition had erupted four or five days earlier.

sentences.zh: 臣意即為柔湯使服之，十八日所而病愈。

translations.literal: Minister Yi then made soft soup to have him drink it, in about eighteen days the illness was cured.
translations.idiomatic: I prepared a Softening Decoction for him to drink, and after roughly eighteen days his illness was cured.

sentences.zh: 濟北王侍者韓女病要背痛，寒熱，眾醫皆以為寒熱也。

translations.literal: Jibei King's attendant Han Nv fell ill with waist and back pain, alternating cold and heat, all doctors considered it alternating cold and heat.
translations.idiomatic: Han Nv, an attendant of the King of Jibei, fell ill with pain in her lower back and alternating chills and fever. The other physicians all diagnosed her condition as simply alternating chills and fever.

sentences.zh: 臣意診脈，曰：「內寒，月事不下也。」

translations.literal: I felt her pulse and said: "Internal cold—the monthly flow has not descended."
translations.idiomatic: On reading her pulse I said: "This is internal cold; her menses have not come down."

sentences.zh: 即竄以藥，旋下，病已。

translations.literal: Then administered medicine with a probe, immediately descended, illness cured.
translations.idiomatic: I administered the medicine by means of a suppository, and it brought immediate expulsion. The illness was cured.

sentences.zh: 病得之欲男子而不可得也。

translations.literal: Illness came from desiring men but unable to obtain.
translations.idiomatic: The illness had arisen from sexual desire that went unfulfilled.

sentences.zh: 所以知韓女之病者，診其脈時，切之，腎脈也，嗇而不屬。

translations.literal: The reason I knew Han Nv's illness was when diagnosing her pulse, cutting it—kidney pulse, constricted yet not connected.
translations.idiomatic: The way I identified Han Nv's illness was by reading her pulse: it showed a kidney pattern, constricted and discontinuous.

sentences.zh: 嗇而不屬者，其來難，堅，故曰月不下。

translations.literal: Constricted yet not connected means its coming difficult, firm, therefore called months not descending.
translations.idiomatic: A constricted, discontinuous pulse means the pulse arrives with difficulty and feels firm—this indicates that the menses have stopped.

sentences.zh: 肝脈弦，出左口，故曰欲男子不可得也。

translations.literal: Liver pulse tense, emerges from left mouth, therefore called desiring men but unable to obtain.
translations.idiomatic: The liver pulse was taut, presenting at the left wrist—this indicated sexual longing that had gone unfulfilled.

sentences.zh: 臨菑氾里女子薄吾病甚，眾醫皆以為寒熱篤，當死，不治。

translations.literal: Linzi Fanli woman Bo Wu ill severely, all doctors considered alternating cold and heat serious, should die, cannot treat.
translations.idiomatic: A woman named Bo Wu from Fanli in Linzi was gravely ill. The other physicians all considered her condition to be a severe case of alternating chills and fever, and they declared she would die and could not be treated.

sentences.zh: 臣意診其脈，曰：「蟯瘕。」

translations.literal: I felt her pulse and said: "Pinworm abdominal mass."
translations.idiomatic: I examined her pulse and diagnosed a pinworm conglomeration.

sentences.zh: 蟯瘕為病，腹大，上膚黃麤，循之戚戚然。

translations.literal: Pinworm abdominal mass as illness, abdomen large, upper skin yellow coarse, following it oppressed oppressed.
translations.idiomatic: The illness was a pinworm-induced abdominal mass: her belly was distended, and the skin over it was yellow and coarse, tender to the touch.

sentences.zh: 臣意飲以芫華一撮，即出蟯可數升，病已，三十日如故。

translations.literal: Minister Yi had her drink yuan hua one pinch, then expelled pinworms several sheng, illness cured, thirty days like before.
translations.idiomatic: I had her drink a pinch of daphne flower medicine, and she expelled several sheng of pinworms. The illness was cured, and within thirty days she was fully restored to her former health.

sentences.zh: 病蟯得之於寒溼，寒溼氣宛篤不發，化為蟲。

translations.literal: Pinworm illness comes from cold dampness, cold dampness energy pent up solid not erupting, transforms into worms.
translations.idiomatic: The pinworm condition arose from cold dampness. When cold, damp energy accumulates and stagnates without being discharged, it transforms into worms.

sentences.zh: 臣意所以知薄吾病者，切其脈，循其尺，其尺索刺麤，而毛美奉發，是蟲氣也。

translations.literal: The reason Minister Yi knew Bo Wu's illness was cutting her pulse, following her chi, her chi rope stabbing coarse, yet hair beautiful flourishing erupted, this is worm energy.
translations.idiomatic: The way I identified Bo Wu's illness was by feeling her pulse and examining her chi position: the chi pulse felt ropy, stabbing, and coarse, yet her body hair was luxuriant and flourishing—this is a sign of worm energy.

sentences.zh: 其色澤者，中藏無邪氣重病。

translations.literal: Her luster means middle viscera without evil energy serious illness.
translations.idiomatic: The healthy luster of her complexion indicated that her internal organs had not been invaded by any serious pathogenic energy.

sentences.zh: 齊淳于司馬病，臣意切其脈，告曰：「當病迵風。

translations.literal: Chunyu Sima of Qi fell ill. I felt his pulse and reported: "He is about to suffer from straight wind."
translations.idiomatic: When Chunyu Sima of Qi took sick, I palpated his pulse and told him: "You are on the verge of straight-wind disease."

sentences.zh: 迵風之狀，飲食下嗌輒後之。

translations.literal: Straight wind's condition, food and drink descend throat then after it.
translations.idiomatic: The symptoms of Penetrating Wind are that food and drink pass down the throat but are promptly expelled.

sentences.zh: 病得之飽食而疾走。」

translations.literal: The illness came from eating his fill and then running hard."
translations.idiomatic: He contracted it by eating to repletion and then hurrying on foot."

sentences.zh: 淳于司馬曰：「我之王家食馬肝，食飽甚，見酒來，即走去，驅疾至舍，即泄數十出。」

translations.literal: Chun Yu si ma said: "I at wang home eat ma gan, eat bao very, see wine come, then go walk, qu ji reach she, then xie shu shi out."
translations.idiomatic: Chunyu Sima said: "I at the king's home ate horse liver, ate very full, saw wine come, then went walking, drove quickly to quarters, then leaked dozens of times."

sentences.zh: 臣意告曰：「為火齊米汁飲之，七八日而當愈。」

translations.literal: I told him: "Drink a decoction of the Fire Formula with rice juice; in seven or eight days you should recover."
translations.idiomatic: I instructed him: "Take the fire-elixir broth mixed with rice water; within seven or eight days you ought to be well."

sentences.zh: 時醫秦信在旁，臣意去，信謂左右閣都尉曰：「意以淳于司馬病為何？」

translations.literal: Time doctor Qin Xin at side, minister Yi go, Xin speak left right ge dou wei said: "Yi with Chun Yu si ma illness become he?"
translations.idiomatic: At the time doctor Qin Xin was at the side, Minister Yi left, Xin told the left and right deputy colonel: "Yi considers Chunyu Sima's illness to be what?"

sentences.zh: 曰：「以為迵風，可治。」

translations.literal: He said: "I take it to be straight wind and that it can be treated."
translations.idiomatic: The patient replied: "I believe it is straight wind and that it may be cured."

sentences.zh: 信即笑曰：「是不知也。

translations.literal: Xin then laugh said: "This not know.
translations.idiomatic: Xin then laughed and said: "This is not knowing.

sentences.zh: 淳于司馬病，法當後九日死。」

translations.literal: Chun Yu si ma illness, law should after nine days die."
translations.idiomatic: Chunyu Sima's illness, by law should die after nine days."

sentences.zh: 即後九日不死，其家復召臣意。

translations.literal: Then after nine days did not die, his family again summoned Minister Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Nine days later, however, he had not died, and his family summoned me again.

sentences.zh: 臣意往問之，盡如意診。

translations.literal: Minister Yi went and asked him, completely like Yi diagnosed.
translations.idiomatic: I went and examined him, and everything was exactly as I had diagnosed.

sentences.zh: 臣即為一火齊米汁，使服之，七八日病已。

translations.literal: Minister then made one fire elixir rice juice, had him take it, seven or eight days illness cured.
translations.idiomatic: I then prepared a Fire Formula Rice Broth and had him drink it. After seven or eight days, the illness was cured.

sentences.zh: 所以知之者，診其脈時，切之，盡如法。

translations.literal: The reason I knew it was when diagnosing his pulse, cutting it, completely like the law.
translations.idiomatic: The way I identified the condition was that when I felt his pulse, the readings corresponded exactly with the textbook patterns.

sentences.zh: 其病順，故不死。

translations.literal: His illness smooth, therefore did not die.
translations.idiomatic: His illness was following a favorable course, and so he did not die.

sentences.zh: 齊中郎破石病，臣意診其脈，告曰：「肺傷，不治，當後十日丁亥溲血死。」

translations.literal: Qi zhong lang Po Shi illness, minister Yi diagnose its pulse, tell said: "Fei hurt, not treat, should after ten days Ding Hai sou blood die."
translations.idiomatic: Qi central colonel Po Shi fell ill, Minister Yi diagnosed his pulse and told him: "Lung injured, cannot treat, should after ten days Dinghai urinate blood and die."

sentences.zh: 即後十一日，溲血而死。

translations.literal: Then after eleven days, urinated blood and died.
translations.idiomatic: Eleven days later, he passed blood in his urine and died.

sentences.zh: 破石之病，得之墮馬僵石上。

translations.literal: Po Shi's illness came from falling from horse stiff on stone.
translations.idiomatic: The illness of the man called Po Shi arose from falling off a horse and landing rigidly on a stone.

sentences.zh: 所以知破石之病者，切其脈，得肺陰氣，其來散，數道至而不一也。

translations.literal: The reason I knew Po Shi's illness was cutting his pulse, obtained lung yin energy, its coming scattered, several paths arrive but not unified.
translations.idiomatic: The way I identified Po Shi's illness was by feeling his pulse: I detected a yin energy pattern in the lungs, arriving in a scattered fashion along several pathways without unifying.

sentences.zh: 色又乘之。

translations.literal: Color moreover multiplied it.
translations.idiomatic: His complexion also confirmed the diagnosis.

sentences.zh: 所以知其墮馬者，切之得番陰脈。

translations.literal: The reason I knew his falling from horse was cutting him obtained flipped yin pulse.
translations.idiomatic: The reason I knew he had fallen from a horse was that when I felt his pulse, I detected a Reversed Yin pattern.

sentences.zh: 番陰脈入虛里，乘肺脈。

translations.literal: Flipped yin pulse enters void li, multiplies lung pulse.
translations.idiomatic: The Reversed Yin pulse enters the Vacuity Interior point and overwhelms the lung pulse.

sentences.zh: 肺脈散者，固色變也乘也。

translations.literal: Lung pulse scattered means firmly color changed also multiplied.
translations.idiomatic: When the lung pulse becomes scattered, the complexion inevitably changes as the condition intensifies.

sentences.zh: 所以不中期死者，師言曰：「病者安穀即過期，不安穀則不及期」。

translations.literal: So not zhong period die person, shi speak say: "Illness person an gu then exceed period, not an gu then not reach period".
translations.idiomatic: The reason not mid-period died is master said: "Illness people settle grain then exceed period, not settle grain then not reach period".

sentences.zh: 其人嗜黍，黍主肺，故過期。

translations.literal: The person liked millet, millet governs lung, therefore exceeded period.
translations.idiomatic: The patient was fond of millet, and since millet corresponds to the lungs, this sustained him beyond the predicted time.

sentences.zh: 所以溲血者，診脈法曰「病養喜陰處者順死，養喜陽處者逆死」。

translations.literal: The reason for the bloody urine: the pulse canon says, "When an illness is nursed in a yin place, death comes smoothly; when nursed in a yang place, death comes contrary."
translations.idiomatic: Why he passed blood: the canon states, "If the sick person is kept in a yin setting, death follows the easy course; if kept in a yang setting, death runs counter."

sentences.zh: 其人喜自靜，不躁，又久安坐，伏几而寐，故血下泄。

translations.literal: The person liked to be quiet by himself, not agitated, moreover long sat peacefully, leaned on table and slept, therefore blood leaked downward.
translations.idiomatic: The man was fond of solitude and calm, never agitated. Moreover, he sat still for long periods, resting his head on a table to sleep. Because of this, the blood leaked downward.

sentences.zh: 齊王侍醫遂病，自練五石服之。

translations.literal: Qi king's attendant physician Sui fell ill, personally refined five stones and took them.
translations.idiomatic: Sui, an attendant physician to the King of Qi, fell ill. He personally refined a Five Mineral Powder and took it.

sentences.zh: 臣意往過之，遂謂意曰：「不肖有病，幸診遂也。」

translations.literal: Minister Yi go pass it, sui speak minister Yi said: "Not xiao have illness, fortunate diagnose sui."
translations.idiomatic: Minister Yi went to visit him, Sui told Minister Yi: "I have illness, fortunately diagnose me."

sentences.zh: 臣意即診之，告曰：「公病中熱。

translations.literal: Minister Yi then diagnose it, tell said: "Gong illness zhong hot.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Yi then diagnosed him and said: "Your lordship's illness is middle heat.

sentences.zh: 論曰『中熱不溲者，不可服五石』。

translations.literal: Lun say "zhong hot not sou person, not able fu wu shi".
translations.idiomatic: The discussion says "middle heat without urination cannot take five stones".

sentences.zh: 石之為藥精悍，公服之不得數溲，亟勿服。

translations.literal: Stone medicine is refined and fierce, your lordship taking it cannot urinate frequently, urgently do not take.
translations.idiomatic: Mineral medicines are extremely potent. Since you, sir, have difficulty urinating frequently enough, you must stop taking them at once.

sentences.zh: 色將發臃。」

translations.literal: Color will fa yong."
translations.idiomatic: Color will swell."

sentences.zh: 遂曰：「扁鵲曰『陰石以治陰病，陽石以治陽病』。

translations.literal: Sui said: "Bian Que say "yin shi with treat yin illness, yang shi with treat yang illness".
translations.idiomatic: Sui said: "Bian Que said 'yin stones treat yin illness, yang stones treat yang illness.'

sentences.zh: 夫藥石者有陰陽水火之齊，故中熱，即為陰石柔齊治之；

translations.literal: Fu medicine shi person have yin yang shui huo zhi qi, therefore zhong hot, then become yin shi rou qi treat it;
translations.idiomatic: Because medicine stones have yin yang water fire preparations, therefore for middle heat, then use yin stones soft preparation to treat it;

sentences.zh: 中寒，即為陽石剛齊治之。」

translations.literal: Zhong han, then become yang shi gang qi treat it."
translations.idiomatic: For middle cold, then use yang stones firm preparation to treat it."

sentences.zh: 臣意曰：「公所論遠矣。

translations.literal: Minister Yi said: "Gong suo lun yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Yi said: "What your lordship discusses is far-reaching.

sentences.zh: 扁鵲雖言若是，然必審診，起度量，立規矩，稱權衡，合色脈表裏有餘不足順逆之法，參其人動靜與息相應，乃可以論。

translations.literal: Though Bian Que spoke like this, yet must carefully diagnose, establish measurements, set up rules, weigh balances, combine color pulse surface interior excess deficiency normal reverse methods, examine the person's movement stillness with breathing corresponding, then can discuss.
translations.idiomatic: Though Bian Que spoke in this manner, one must still conduct a thorough examination: establish measurements, set up standards, weigh balances, and integrate the methods of reading complexion and pulse, distinguishing exterior and interior, excess and deficiency, favorable and unfavorable courses. One must also observe whether the patient's movements, stillness, and breathing correspond with one another—only then can a proper discussion of the case begin.

sentences.zh: 論曰『陽疾處內，陰形應外者，不加悍藥及鑱石』。

translations.literal: Lun say "yang ji chu nei, yin xing ying wai person, not add han medicine and zan shi".
translations.idiomatic: The discussion says "yang illness resides internally, yin form responds externally, do not add fierce medicine and needles stones".

sentences.zh: 夫悍藥入中，則邪氣辟矣，而宛氣愈深。

translations.literal: Because fierce medicine enters center, then evil energy repels, but pent energy goes deeper.
translations.idiomatic: When powerful medicines enter the body, they may drive out pathogenic energy, yet the stagnant energy only sinks deeper.

sentences.zh: 診法曰『二陰應外，一陽接內者，不可以剛藥』。

translations.literal: Zhen fa say "two yin ying wai, one yang jie nei person, not able with gang medicine".
translations.idiomatic: Diagnosis method says "two yin respond externally, one yang connects internally, cannot use firm medicine".

sentences.zh: 剛藥入則動陽，陰病益衰，陽病益箸，邪氣流行，為重困於俞，忿發為疽。」

translations.literal: Gang medicine enter then dong yang, yin illness yi cui, yang illness yi zhu, xie qi liu dong, become zhong kun yu shu, fen fa become ju."
translations.idiomatic: Firm medicine enters then moves yang, yin illness increasingly declines, yang illness increasingly attaches, evil energy flows, becomes heavily trapped at the transport points, anger erupts into carbuncle."

sentences.zh: 意告之後百餘日，果為疽發乳上，入缺盆，死。

translations.literal: After Yi told him over a hundred days, indeed became carbuncle erupting on breast, entered supraclavicular fossa, died.
translations.idiomatic: More than a hundred days after I warned him, a carbuncle erupted on his breast and spread into the supraclavicular region. He died.

sentences.zh: 此謂論之大體也，必有經紀。

translations.literal: This speaks of the great outline of discussion, must have classics and records.
translations.idiomatic: This is the broad framework of medical reasoning—it must always be grounded in the classical texts and their principles.

sentences.zh: 拙工有一不習，文理陰陽失矣。

translations.literal: Clumsy work has one not practiced, pattern principle yin yang lost.
translations.idiomatic: If an unskilled practitioner neglects even one aspect of his training, his grasp of the patterns, principles, and the interplay of yin and yang will be lost.

sentences.zh: 齊王故為陽虛侯時，病甚，眾醫皆以為蹷。

translations.literal: When Qi king previously became Yangxu Marquis, fell ill severely, all doctors considered it reversal.
translations.idiomatic: Before the King of Qi received his royal title, back when he was still the Marquis of Yangxu, he fell gravely ill. The other physicians all diagnosed it as a reversal condition.

sentences.zh: 臣意診脈，以為痹，根在右脅下，大如覆杯，令人喘，逆氣不能食。

translations.literal: Minister Yi diagnosed pulse, considered it blockage, root in right rib below, large like overturned cup, made person pant, adverse energy could not eat.
translations.idiomatic: When I examined his pulse, I diagnosed it as a blockage condition. The root of the disease was located below the right ribs, as large as an overturned cup. It caused labored breathing, and the counterflow energy prevented him from eating.

sentences.zh: 臣意即以火齊粥且飲，六日氣下；

translations.literal: Minister Yi then with fire qi zhou qie drink, six days qi xia;
translations.idiomatic: Minister Yi then with fire elixir congee to drink, six days energy descended;

sentences.zh: 即令更服丸藥，出入六日，病已。

translations.literal: Then had him take pill medicine more, coming and going six days, illness cured.
translations.idiomatic: I then had him continue taking pill medicine, and after six days of treatment the illness was cured.

sentences.zh: 病得之內。

translations.literal: Illness came from internal.
translations.idiomatic: The illness had arisen from sexual indulgence.

sentences.zh: 診之時不能識其經解，大識其病所在。

translations.literal: At diagnosis time could not identify its classic solution, greatly identified its illness location.
translations.idiomatic: At the time of my diagnosis, I could not identify the precise channel through which the illness would resolve, but I could clearly identify where the disease was located.

sentences.zh: 臣意嘗診安陽武都裏成開方，開方自言以為不病，臣意謂之病苦沓風，三歲四支不能自用，使人瘖，瘖即死。

translations.literal: Minister Yi once diagnosed Anyang Wudu quarter Cheng Kaifang, Kaifang himself said not ill, Minister Yi told him ill suffering great wind, three years four limbs cannot use themselves, makes person mute, mute then dies.
translations.idiomatic: I once examined Cheng Kaifang from the Wudu quarter of Anyang. Kaifang insisted he was not ill, but I told him he was suffering from a severe wind condition: within three years his four limbs would lose their function, he would become mute, and once mute, he would die.

sentences.zh: 今聞其四支不能用，瘖而未死也。

translations.literal: Now hear his four limbs cannot use, mute but not yet died.
translations.idiomatic: I have now heard that his four limbs have indeed lost their function and that he has gone mute, though he has not yet died.

sentences.zh: 病得之數飲酒以見大風氣。

translations.literal: Illness came from frequently drinking wine and encountering great wind energy.
translations.idiomatic: The illness arose from habitual drinking combined with exposure to strong wind energy.

sentences.zh: 所以知成開方病者，診之，其脈法奇咳言曰「藏氣相反者死」。

translations.literal: So know Cheng Kai Fang illness, diagnose it, its pulse fa qi gu hai speak "zang qi xiang fan person die".
translations.idiomatic: The reason I knew Cheng Kaifang's illness was diagnosing him, his pulse method strange cough said "visceral energies opposing die".

sentences.zh: 切之，得腎反肺，法曰「三歲死」也。

translations.literal: Cut it, get shen fan fei, fa say "three years die".
translations.idiomatic: Cut it, obtained kidney opposing lung, law says "three years die".

sentences.zh: 安陵阪裏公乘項處病，臣意診脈，曰：「牡疝。」

translations.literal: An Ling Ban Li Gong Cheng Xiang Chu illness, minister Yi diagnose pulse, said: "Mu shan."
translations.idiomatic: Anling Banli Gongcheng Xiang Chu fell ill, Minister Yi diagnosed pulse, said: "Male hernia."

sentences.zh: 牡疝在鬲下，上連肺。

translations.literal: Male hernia at diaphragm below, above connects lung.
translations.idiomatic: The firm hernia was located below the diaphragm, extending upward to connect with the lungs.

sentences.zh: 病得之內。

translations.literal: Illness came from internal.
translations.idiomatic: The illness arose from sexual indulgence.

sentences.zh: 臣意謂之：「慎毋為勞力事，為勞力事則必嘔血死。」

translations.literal: I told him: "Take care not to engage in strenuous labor; if you do strenuous labor you will certainly vomit blood and die."
translations.idiomatic: I warned him: "Be careful not to undertake heavy work. If you exert yourself, you will surely spit blood and perish."

sentences.zh: 處後蹴踘，要蹷寒，汗出多，即嘔血。

translations.literal: After Chu kicked ball, waist reversal cold, sweat came out much, then vomited blood.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward, Chu played a game of kickball. His lower back went cold with a reversal, he broke into a heavy sweat, and then vomited blood.

sentences.zh: 臣意復診之，曰：「當旦日日夕死。」

translations.literal: Minister Yi fu diagnose it, said: "Should dan ri ri xi die."
translations.idiomatic: Minister Yi again diagnosed him and said: "Should tomorrow morning evening die."

sentences.zh: 即死。

translations.literal: Then died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 病得之內。

translations.literal: Illness came from internal.
translations.idiomatic: The illness had originated from sexual indulgence.

sentences.zh: 所以知項處病者，切其脈得番陽。

translations.literal: The reason I knew Xiang Chu's illness was cutting his pulse obtained flipped yang.
translations.idiomatic: The way I identified Xiang Chu's illness was by feeling his pulse: I detected a Reversed Yang pattern.

sentences.zh: 番陽入虛裏，處旦日死。

translations.literal: Flipped yang enters void li, Chu tomorrow dies.
translations.idiomatic: The Reversed Yang pulse had entered the Vacuity Interior point—Chu would die the next morning.

sentences.zh: 一番一絡者，牡疝也。

translations.literal: One flipped one network vessel means male hernia.
translations.idiomatic: When one pulse is reversed and one is in the connecting vessel, the diagnosis is a firm hernia.

sentences.zh: 臣意曰：他所診期決死生及所治已病眾多，久頗忘之，不能盡識，不敢以對。

translations.literal: Minister Yi said: he suo diagnose period decide death life and suo treat already illness zhong duo, long po wang it, not able jin shi, not gan with dui.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Yi said: Other diagnoses of period decisions death life and treated cured illnesses numerous, long somewhat forgot them, cannot completely identify, dare not answer.

sentences.zh: 問臣意：「所診治病，病名多同而診異，或死或不死，何也？」

translations.literal: Ask minister Yi: "Suo diagnose treat illness, illness name duo tong yet diagnose yi, or die or not die, what?"
translations.idiomatic: Asked Minister Yi: "Diagnosed treated illnesses, illness names mostly same but diagnoses different, some die some not die, why?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「病名多相類，不可知，故古聖人為之脈法，以起度量，立規矩，縣權衡，案繩墨，調陰陽，別人之脈各名之，與天地相應，參合於人，故乃別百病以異之，有數者能異之，無數者同之。

translations.literal: Dui said: "Illness name duo xiang lei, not able know, therefore gu sheng ren become it pulse fa, with qi du liang, li gui ju, xuan quan heng, an sheng mo, diao yin yang, bie ren zhi pulse ge ming it, with tian di xiang ying, can he yu ren, therefore then bie bai illness with yi it, have shu person able yi it, no shu person tong it.
translations.idiomatic: Answered: "Illness names mostly similar, cannot know, therefore ancient sages made pulse method for it, to establish measurements, set rules, hang balances, press ink lines, regulate yin yang, distinguish people's pulses each name them, with heaven earth corresponding, examine combine with person, therefore then distinguish hundred illnesses to differentiate them, having numbers can differentiate them, no numbers make same.

sentences.zh: 然脈法不可勝驗，診疾人以度異之，乃可別同名，命病主在所居。

translations.literal: But pulse method cannot win verification, diagnose ill person with degree differentiate them, then can distinguish same names, name illness master in location resided.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the methods of pulse diagnosis are beyond exhaustive verification. One must examine each patient individually and differentiate them by degree, and only then can one distinguish diseases that share the same name and determine the true site where the illness resides.

sentences.zh: 今臣意所診者，皆有診籍。

translations.literal: Now Minister Yi's diagnosed persons, all have diagnosis records.
translations.idiomatic: For all the patients I have examined, I keep case records.

sentences.zh: 所以別之者，臣意所受師方適成，師死，以故表籍所診，期決死生，觀所失所得者合脈法，以故至今知之。」

translations.literal: How I distinguish them: the formulas I received from my teacher had just been completed when my teacher died. For that reason I set down in the register the cases I diagnosed, fixed in advance whether they would live or die, and observed which predictions failed and which succeeded in accord with the pulse canon—therefore I know them to this day."
translations.idiomatic: How I tell them apart: I had only just received my teacher's formulas when he died. I therefore recorded in a table the patients I treated, noting beforehand their outcomes of life or death, and compared successes and failures against the pulse canon—hence I can still identify them today."

sentences.zh: 問臣意曰：「所期病決死生，或不應期，何故？」

translations.literal: Ask minister Yi said: "Suo period illness decide death life, or not ying period, what gu?"
translations.idiomatic: Asked Minister Yi: "Diagnosed period illnesses decide death life, some not respond to period, why?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「此皆飲食喜怒不節，或不當飲藥，或不當鍼灸，以故不中期死也。」

translations.literal: Dui said: "This all eat drink xi nu not jie, or not dang yin medicine, or not dang zhen jiu, with gu not zhong period die."
translations.idiomatic: Answered: "This all eating drinking joy anger not regulated, or not proper drinking medicine, or not proper needle moxa, therefore not mid-period die."

sentences.zh: 問臣意：「意方能知病死生，論藥用所宜，諸侯王大臣有嘗問意者不？

translations.literal: Ask minister Yi: "Yi fang able know illness death life, lun medicine use suo yi, zhu hou wang da chen have chang ask yi person not?
translations.idiomatic: Asked Minister Yi: "Yi just able know illness death life, discuss medicine use appropriate, feudal lords kings ministers have ever asked Yi not?

sentences.zh: 及文王病時，不求意診治，何故？」

translations.literal: And Wen wang illness time, not seek Yi diagnose treat, what gu?"
translations.idiomatic: And when Wen Wang fell ill, why not seek Minister Yi to diagnose and treat?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「趙王、膠西王、濟南王、吳王皆使人來召臣意，臣意不敢往。

translations.literal: Dui said: "Zhao wang, Jiao xi wang, Ji nan wang, Wu wang all make person come summon minister Yi, minister Yi not gan go.
translations.idiomatic: Answered: "Zhao King, Jiaoxi King, Jinan King, Wu King all sent people to summon Minister Yi, Minister Yi dared not go.

sentences.zh: 文王病時，臣意家貧，欲為人治病，誠恐吏以除拘臣意也，故移名數，左右不修家生，出行游國中，問善為方數者事之久矣，見事數師，悉受其要事，盡其方書意，及解論之。

translations.literal: When Wen Wang fell ill, Minister Yi's family was poor, wanted to treat people's illnesses, sincerely feared officials would arrest Minister Yi for practicing without license, therefore changed name and residence, attendants did not attend to family livelihood, went walking and traveling in the state, asked good formula method practitioners to serve them for long periods, saw and served several teachers, all received their essential matters, mastered their formula books and intentions, and solved their discussions.
translations.idiomatic: When King Wen fell ill, my family was poor. I wished to treat patients, but I genuinely feared that officials would seize me for practicing without authorization. Therefore I changed my registered name and residence, neglected my household affairs, and went traveling throughout the state. I sought out skilled practitioners of medicine and studied under them for long periods, attending several teachers and absorbing the essentials of their practice. I mastered the contents and reasoning of their medical texts and worked through their theoretical discussions.

sentences.zh: 身居陽虛侯國，因事侯。

translations.literal: Personally resided in Yangxu Marquis's fief, because of serving the marquis.
translations.idiomatic: I took up residence in the fief of the Marquis of Yangxu, where I entered the marquis's service.

sentences.zh: 侯入朝，臣意從之長安，以故得診安陵項處等病也。」

translations.literal: Hou enter chao, minister Yi from it Chang an, with gu get diagnose An ling Xiang chu deng illness."
translations.idiomatic: Marquis entered court, Minister Yi followed him to Chang'an, therefore got to diagnose Anling Xiang Chu and others' illnesses."

sentences.zh: 問臣意：「知文王所以得病不起之狀？」

translations.literal: Ask minister Yi: "Know Wen wang so get illness not rise zhi zhuang?"
translations.idiomatic: Asked Minister Yi: "Know Wen Wang's illness such that he could not rise condition?"

sentences.zh: 臣意對曰：「不見文王病，然竊聞文王病喘，頭痛，目不明。

translations.literal: Minister Yi dui said: "Not see Wen wang illness, ran she hear Wen wang illness chuan, tou tong, mu not ming.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Yi answered: "Did not see Wen Wang's illness, but secretly heard Wen Wang's illness panting, head pain, eyes not clear.

sentences.zh: 臣意心論之，以為非病也。

translations.literal: Minister Yi internally discussed it, considered it not illness.
translations.idiomatic: I considered the matter carefully and concluded that it was not an illness.

sentences.zh: 以為肥而蓄精，身體不得搖，骨肉不相任，故喘，不當醫治。

translations.literal: Considered it obesity yet storing essence, body not able to move, bones and flesh not mutually supporting, therefore panting, should not be medically treated.
translations.idiomatic: I believed his condition was simply that he had grown fat and his essence had accumulated, leaving his body unable to move freely and his bones and muscles unable to support each other. This caused the shortness of breath, and it did not warrant medical treatment.

sentences.zh: 脈法曰『年二十脈氣當趨，年三十當疾步，年四十當安坐，年五十當安臥，年六十已上氣當大董』。

translations.literal: Mai fa say "year twenty mai qi dang qu, year thirty dang ji bu, year forty dang an zuo, year fifty dang an wo, year sixty yi shang qi dang da dong".
translations.idiomatic: Pulse method says "age twenty pulse energy should hasten, age thirty should quick step, age forty should peacefully sit, age fifty should peacefully lie, age sixty and above energy should greatly move".

sentences.zh: 文王年未滿二十，方脈氣之趨也而徐之，不應天道四時。

translations.literal: Wen Wang's age not yet full twenty, just at pulse energy should hasten yet slow it, not responding to heaven way four seasons.
translations.idiomatic: King Wen was not yet twenty years old. At his age, the pulse and vital energy should have been vigorous, yet his were sluggish—they did not respond to the seasonal rhythms of heaven.

sentences.zh: 後聞醫灸之即篤，此論病之過也。

translations.literal: Later heard physician moxa burned him then serious, this discusses illness's excess.
translations.idiomatic: Later I heard that after a physician applied moxibustion, his condition turned critical. This was an error in the approach to his illness.

sentences.zh: 臣意論之，以為神氣爭而邪氣入，非年少所能復之也，以故死。

translations.literal: Minister Yi discussed it, considered it spirit energy contending yet evil energy entered, not young age able to restore it, therefore died.
translations.idiomatic: I reasoned that his spirit energy was contending with the pathogenic energy that had entered, and that his youth was insufficient to restore the balance. For this reason, he died.

sentences.zh: 所謂氣者，當調飲食，擇晏日，車步廣志，以適筋骨肉血脈，以瀉氣。

translations.literal: What is called energy, should regulate eating drinking, choose leisurely days, carriage walking broaden will, to relax muscles bones flesh blood vessels, to drain energy.
translations.idiomatic: The proper way to manage the vital energy is to regulate one's diet, choose restful days, take rides and walks to broaden the spirit, relax the sinews, bones, flesh, and blood vessels, and thus allow the energy to flow freely.

sentences.zh: 故年二十，是謂『易眢』。

translations.literal: Therefore year twenty, this speak "yi dang".
translations.idiomatic: Therefore age twenty, this is called 'easy storage.'

sentences.zh: 法不當砭灸，砭灸至氣逐。」

translations.literal: Fa not dang bian jiu, bian jiu reach qi zhu."
translations.idiomatic: Method not proper needle moxa, needle moxa causes energy to expel."

sentences.zh: 問臣意：「師慶安受之？

translations.literal: Ask minister Yi: "Shi Qing an shou it?
translations.idiomatic: Asked Minister Yi: "Shi Qing received it from whom?

sentences.zh: 聞於齊諸侯不？」

translations.literal: Hear yu Qi zhu hou not?"
translations.idiomatic: Heard from Qi feudal lords not?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「不知慶所師受。

translations.literal: Dui said: "Not know Qing suo shi shou.
translations.idiomatic: Answered: "Do not know Qing's teacher received from.

sentences.zh: 慶家富，善為醫，不肯為人治病，當以此故不聞。

translations.literal: Qing's family rich, good at medicine, unwilling to treat people's illnesses, probably for this reason not heard.
translations.idiomatic: Qing's family was wealthy. Though he was skilled in medicine, he was unwilling to treat patients, which is probably why he was never widely known.

sentences.zh: 慶又告臣意曰：『慎毋令我子孫知若學我方也。』」

translations.literal: Qing again tell minister Yi said: "Shen wu ling wo zi sun know ruo xue wo fang.""
translations.idiomatic: Qing moreover told Minister Yi: 'Carefully do not let my descendants know you studied my formulas.'"

sentences.zh: 問臣意：「師慶何見於意而愛意，欲悉教意方？」

translations.literal: Ask minister Yi: "Shi Qing he see yu Yi yet ai Yi, yu all jiao Yi fang?"
translations.idiomatic: Asked Minister Yi: "Shi Qing what saw in Yi yet loved Yi, wanted to completely teach Yi formulas?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「臣意不聞師慶為方善也。

translations.literal: Dui said: "Minister Yi not hear shi Qing become fang shan.
translations.idiomatic: Answered: "Minister Yi did not hear Shi Qing good at formulas.

sentences.zh: 意所以知慶者，意少時好諸方事，臣意試其方，皆多驗，精良。

translations.literal: The reason Yi knew Qing was Yi young time liked various formula matters, Minister Yi tested his formulas, all many verified, refined good.
translations.idiomatic: The way I came to know Qing was that from a young age I was devoted to the study of various medical formulas. When I tested his formulas, they proved effective in the great majority of cases—refined and reliable.

sentences.zh: 臣意聞菑川唐裏公孫光善為古傳方，臣意即往謁之。

translations.literal: Minister Yi heard Zichuan Tangli Gongsun Guang good at ancient transmitted formulas, Minister Yi then went to visit him.
translations.idiomatic: I heard that Gongsun Guang from Tangli in Zichuan was skilled in the ancient transmitted formulas, and so I went to pay him a visit.

sentences.zh: 得見事之，受方化陰陽及傳語法，臣意悉受書之。

translations.literal: Got to see and serve him, received formula transformed yin yang and transmitted secret methods, Minister Yi all received and wrote them.
translations.idiomatic: I was permitted to attend him and received his formulas for transforming yin and yang, along with his orally transmitted methods. I received and recorded all of them in writing.

sentences.zh: 臣意欲盡受他精方，公孫光曰：『吾方盡矣，不為愛公所。

translations.literal: Minister Yi yu jin shou he jing fang, Gong sun Guang said: "Wu fang jin, not become ai gong suo.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Yi wanted to completely receive other refined formulas, Gongsun Guang said: "My formulas exhausted, not for loving you withhold.

sentences.zh: 吾身已衰，無所復事之。

translations.literal: My body already declined, nothing more to serve.
translations.idiomatic: My body has already declined, and there is nothing more I can offer you.

sentences.zh: 是吾年少所受妙方也，悉與公，毋以教人。』

translations.literal: This wu year shao suo shou miao fang, all with gong, wu with jiao ren."
translations.idiomatic: These are my young age received marvelous formulas, all give to you, do not teach people."

sentences.zh: 臣意曰：『得見事侍公前，悉得禁方，幸甚。

translations.literal: Minister Yi said: "Get see shi shi gong qian, all get jin fang, xing very.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Yi said: "Got to see and serve before you, all received forbidden formulas, fortunate very.

sentences.zh: 意死不敢妄傳人。』

translations.literal: Yi die not gan wang chuan ren."
translations.idiomatic: Yi die dare not recklessly transmit to people."

sentences.zh: 居有閒，公孫光閒處，臣意深論方，見言百世為之精也。

translations.literal: Resided with leisure, Gongsun Guang idle place, Minister Yi deeply discussed formulas, saw speech hundred generations make them refined.
translations.idiomatic: After some time, when Gongsun Guang was at leisure, I engaged him in a deep discussion of medical formulas. I saw from his words that these traditions had been refined over the course of a hundred generations.

sentences.zh: 師光喜曰：『公必為國工。

translations.literal: Shi Guang xi said: "Gong must become guo gong.
translations.idiomatic: Teacher Guang happily said: "You must become state craftsman.

sentences.zh: 吾有所善者皆疏，同產處臨菑，善為方，吾不若，其方甚奇，非世之所聞也。

translations.literal: My good ones all distant, same birth place Linzi, good at formulas, I not equal, his formulas very strange, not world heard.
translations.idiomatic: All the truly skilled practitioners I know are far away. But there is one from my hometown who lives in Linzi—he is excellent at formulas, far beyond my own ability. His formulas are truly extraordinary, unlike anything the world has heard of.

sentences.zh: 吾年中時，嘗欲受其方，楊中倩不肯，曰「若非其人也」。

translations.literal: In my middle years I once wished to receive his formulas, but Yang Zhongqian would not agree, saying, "You are not the right person."
translations.idiomatic: During my middle years I sought to learn his prescriptions, but Yang Zhongqian refused, saying, "You are not the man for them."

sentences.zh: 胥與公往見之，當知公喜方也。

translations.literal: Together with you go see him, should know you love formulas.
translations.idiomatic: Let me take you to see him. He will surely recognize your love of medicine.

sentences.zh: 其人亦老矣，其家給富。』

translations.literal: Its person yi lao, its home ji fu."
translations.idiomatic: That person also old, his family sufficient rich."

sentences.zh: 時者未往，會慶子男殷來獻馬，因師光奏馬王所，意以故得與殷善。

translations.literal: At the time not yet gone, met Qing's son Yin come present horses, because Teacher Guang presented horses to king place, Yi therefore got with Yin good.
translations.idiomatic: Before we could make the visit, Qing's son Yin happened to come and present horses. Since Master Guang was presenting horses to the king at the same time, I had the opportunity to become acquainted with Yin.

sentences.zh: 光又屬意於殷曰：『意好數，公必謹遇之，其人聖儒。』

translations.literal: Guang again shu Yi yu Yin said: "Yi hao shu, gong must jin yu it, its person sheng ru."
translations.idiomatic: Guang moreover entrusted Yi to Yin: "Yi loves numbers, you must carefully treat him, that person sage confucian."

sentences.zh: 即為書以意屬陽慶，以故知慶。

translations.literal: Then made letter with Yi entrusted Yang Qing, therefore knew Qing.
translations.idiomatic: Guang then wrote a letter commending me to Yang Qing, and this is how I came to know Qing.

sentences.zh: 臣意事慶謹，以故愛意也。」

translations.literal: Minister Yi shi Qing jin, with gu ai Yi."
translations.idiomatic: Minister Yi served Qing carefully, therefore Qing loved Yi."

sentences.zh: 問臣意曰：「吏民嘗有事學意方，及畢盡得意方不？

translations.literal: Ask minister Yi said: "Li min chang have shi xue Yi fang, and bi jin de Yi fang not?
translations.idiomatic: Asked Minister Yi: "Officials people ever had matters study Yi formulas, and completely exhausted got Yi formulas not?

sentences.zh: 何縣里人？」

translations.literal: He xian li ren?"
translations.idiomatic: What county quarter person?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「臨菑人宋邑。

translations.literal: Dui said: "Lin Zi ren Song Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Answered: "Linzi person Song Yi.

sentences.zh: 邑學，臣意教以五診，歲餘。

translations.literal: Yi studied, Minister Yi taught with five diagnoses, year remaining.
translations.idiomatic: He studied under me, and I taught him the Five Methods of Diagnosis over the course of more than a year.

sentences.zh: 濟北王遣太醫高期、王禹學，臣意教以經脈高下及奇絡結，當論俞所居，及氣當上下出入邪［正］逆順，以宜鑱石，定砭灸處，歲餘。

translations.literal: Jibei King sent imperial physician Gao Qi, Wang Yu study, Minister Yi taught with classic vessels high low and strange network knots, should discuss transport points location, and energy should up down exit enter evil correct reverse normal, to appropriate needle stones, determine needle moxa places, year remaining.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Jibei sent the imperial physician Gao Qi and Wang Yu to study under me. I taught them the upper and lower channel pathways, the extraordinary connecting vessels and their junctures, the discussion of transport point locations, and the theory of how vital energy rises, descends, enters, and exits—whether in pathogenic or proper, adverse or favorable patterns—as well as the appropriate use of needles and stone instruments and the determination of acupuncture and moxibustion sites. This took over a year.

sentences.zh: 菑川王時遣太倉馬長馮信正方，臣意教以案法逆順，論藥法，定五味及和齊湯法。

translations.literal: Zichuan King time sent imperial granary horse director Feng Xin correct formulas, Minister Yi taught with pressing method reverse normal, discuss medicine method, determine five flavors and harmonize preparation decoction method.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Zichuan at one time sent Feng Xin, the Director of Horses for the Imperial Granary, to study proper formulas. I taught him the pressing method and its favorable and adverse applications, the theory of pharmacology, and the determination of the five flavors and the preparation and harmonizing of decoctions.

sentences.zh: 高永侯家丞杜信，喜脈，來學，臣意教以上下經脈五診，二歲餘。

translations.literal: Gaoyong Marquis house overseer Du Xin, loved pulses, came study, Minister Yi taught with upper lower classic vessels five diagnoses, two years remaining.
translations.idiomatic: Du Xin, the household steward of the Marquis of Gaoyong, was devoted to pulse reading and came to study under me. I taught him the upper and lower channel pathways and the Five Methods of Diagnosis over the course of more than two years.

sentences.zh: 臨菑召裏唐安來學，臣意教以五診上下經脈，奇咳，四時應陰陽重，未成，除為齊王侍醫。」

translations.literal: Lin Zi zhao li Tang An come xue, minister Yi jiao with wu zhen shang xia jing mai, qi gai, four shi ying yin yang zhong, not cheng, chu become Qi wang shi yi."
translations.idiomatic: Linzi Zhao quarter Tang An came study, Minister Yi taught with five diagnoses upper lower classic vessels, strange cough, four seasons respond yin yang heavy, not completed, appointed as Qi king attendant physician."

sentences.zh: 問臣意：「診病決死生，能全無失乎？」

translations.literal: Ask minister Yi: "Zhen illness jue death life, able quan no shi hu?"
translations.idiomatic: Asked Minister Yi: "Diagnose illness decide death life, able completely no loss not?"

sentences.zh: 臣意對曰：「意治病人，必先切其脈，乃治之。

translations.literal: Minister Yi dui said: "Yi zhi illness person, must xian cut its pulse, then zhi it.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Yi answered: "Yi treats ill people, must first cut their pulse, then treat them.

sentences.zh: 敗逆者不可治，其順者乃治之。

translations.literal: Declining reverse ones cannot treat, the smooth ones then treat them.
translations.idiomatic: Those whose conditions have deteriorated into an adverse pattern cannot be treated; only those whose conditions follow a favorable course can be treated.

sentences.zh: 心不精脈，所期死生視可治，時時失之，臣意不能全也。」

translations.literal: If the heart is not intent upon the pulse, the expected outcomes of life and death and what can be treated—even when one is sometimes wrong—I cannot be perfect in all cases."
translations.idiomatic: When the mind is not fully concentrated on the pulse, the foreseen outcomes of life and death and what may be cured—even though one is sometimes mistaken—I cannot be wholly accurate."

sentences.zh: 太史公曰：女無美惡，居宮見妒；

translations.literal: Tai shi gong said: nu no mei e, ju gong see du;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Scribe said: Woman no beautiful ugly, reside palace see jealousy;

sentences.zh: 士無賢不肖，入朝見疑。

translations.literal: Scholar no worthy unworthy, enter court see suspicion.
translations.idiomatic: Regardless of whether a man is virtuous or unworthy, upon entering the court he will be met with suspicion.

sentences.zh: 故扁鵲以其伎見殃，倉公乃匿跡自隱而當刑。

translations.literal: Therefore Bian Que with his skill saw calamity, Cang Gong then hid traces self concealed yet suffered punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Bian Que, through his very skill, brought calamity upon himself, and the Grand Granary Master concealed his tracks and hid away, yet still faced criminal punishment.

sentences.zh: 緹縈通尺牘，父得以後寧。

translations.literal: Ti Ying presented bamboo slip, father thereby afterward peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: It was Tiying who delivered a letter on a foot-long bamboo slip, and thereby her father was able to find peace in the end.

sentences.zh: 故老子曰「美好者不祥之器」，豈謂扁鵲等邪？

translations.literal: Therefore Lao Zi said "mei hao person not xiang zhi qi", qi speak Bian Que deng xie?
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Laozi said "beautiful good ones inauspicious vessels", how speak Bian Que and such?

sentences.zh: 若倉公者，可謂近之矣。

translations.literal: Like Cang Gong, can be said near it.
translations.idiomatic: A man such as the Grand Granary Master may be said to have come close to this ideal.
